headword: {申|もう}し{訳|わけ}ありません
reading: もうしわけありません
gloss: I'm very sorry; I sincerely apologize

definitions.gloss: I'm very sorry; I sincerely apologize; there is no excuse
definitions.explanation: A formal and polite expression of apology, stronger than すみません. Literally means 'there is no excuse,' conveying deep regret and acknowledgment that one's actions were inexcusable.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大変|たいへん}→大変：00594_taihen⟧{申|もう}し{訳|わけ}ありません。
⟦お{待|ま}たせ→お待たせ：27262_omatase⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧{申|もう}し{訳|わけ}ありません。
examples.english: I'm sorry for keeping you waiting.

examples.japanese: ⟦ご{迷惑|めいわく}→ご迷惑：28069_gomeiwaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧おかけ⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{誠|まこと}→誠：27623_makoto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{申|もう}し{訳|わけ}ありません。⟦{今後|こんご}→今後：02808_kongo⟧⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧ようなこと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧よう⟦{十分|じゅうぶん}→十分：01614_juubun⟧⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦いたします→いたす：01314_itasu⟧。
examples.english: I sincerely apologize for the inconvenience. I will take every care to ensure this does not happen again.

notes:
One of the most important formal apology expressions in Japanese. Literally means "there is no excuse" (⟦{申|もう}し{訳|わけ}→申し訳：03810_moushiwake⟧ = excuse + ⟦ありません→ある：00006_aru⟧ = does not exist). Used in business, customer service, and any situation requiring a sincere, polite apology.

FORMALITY LEVELS:
- ⟦{申|もう}し{訳|わけ}ない→申し訳ない：20352_moushiwakenai⟧: casual/plain form
- {申|もう}し{訳|わけ}ありません: polite form (standard)
- ⟦{申|もう}し{訳|わけ}ございません→申し訳ございません：18087_moushiwakegozaimasen⟧: very polite/humble form (business, customer service)

COMMON INTENSIFIERS:
- ⟦{大変|たいへん}→大変：00594_taihen⟧{申|もう}し{訳|わけ}ありません: I am terribly sorry
- ⟦{誠|まこと}→誠：27623_makoto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{申|もう}し{訳|わけ}ありません: I am sincerely sorry (very formal)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- すみません: sorry/excuse me — lighter, everyday apology; also used to get attention
- ⟦ごめんなさい→ごめんなさい：00931_gomennasai⟧: I'm sorry — more personal and informal; used between friends and family
- ⟦{失礼|しつれい}しました→失礼する：15203_shitsureisuru⟧: excuse me (for what I did) — used for minor social infractions
